source_evidence: Exact player 'Yes lets inspect' accepts inspection of the now-accessible lower chamber and records. Day331~17:40–18:15, Ossric leads V/Cirren/Fenar down the existing stairs through opened door to damp substantially drained 30x20 custody room. The two skeletons remain nonaggressive under his prior instructions. Ossric shows the actual raised archive niche; Fenar uses existing safe footing/rope assistance to facilitate ordinary examination, no hazardous climb or magical effect. Fixed prep dm-estate-ancestry.md @f4b7f371448c8ef2d2b5f3c3467ac843b8b0f291 lines72–83,101–103,114,188,216,222: engraved bronze/stone route instrument, lidded ceramic container with two inscribed metal leaves, historic sealed travel coffer containing old coin equivalent to180gp and nonmagical keepsakes. Ossric opens coffer for inspection as custodian, Cirren estimates metal value, no currency transfer or ownership assumption; originals and coffer remain in site custody. Ossric explains the older lettering and provides his firsthand perspective; servant record paraphrase faithfully preserves two fixed facts: household gave refuge/shared stores, later warders barred exit despite servant's request to release sheltered people. His expressed regret is genuine present NPC response, not exoneration. No father order, child memory, exact date, fate of wards, identity/function of heart's speaker proved. Physical evidence corroborates in-place House affiliation and old heart recovery/packing district, not manufacture. Cirren requests Mara's survey assistance; she voluntarily visits for comparison while Hessa's husband agrees to watch the stationary coach/team on the surface, no paid labor or relocation; Mara rejoins coach afterward. Cirren/Mara make durable working copies of dedication, charter/route instrument and readable servant account, corroborate Orsaven field-book sketch with surviving aqueduct/route instrument. Actual main-approach bearing established west-northwest inland from crossing, newly fixed local directional design detail (no exact azimuth, coordinates, distance, route or destination safety/title asserted). Gallery charter preserves upkeep/refuge and limitation on demanding service without protection; station reference can be compared to current western customs tower documentation, no present crime established. Copy time20min plus ordinary inspection/translation/comparison~15min; no finite spell, skill roll or price. Basic documentary conclusions are accessible under prep; ancient wording interpreted with warder's firsthand linguistic help, no universal translation, exact nonessential titulature/date remains uncertain. Hessa's protected landing and boat undamaged, safe drainage unchanged, both warders remain provisional guardians. V may decide disposition of historic coffer/next actions; no salvage taken, payment earned/received yet, no automatic title, inspection certification, legal authority, or additional quest acceptance. Day331~18:15. New copies held by party (Mara authenticated survey additions, Cirren journal/working notes), originals unchanged at site.
